title: Validate output and add selective quality review
description: Validate structured responses, preserve partial valid work, run deterministic checks, and invoke at most one bounded selective review pass only when justified or requested.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown/duplicate/missing/invalid results are handled safely; clean batches receive no review; only suspicious IDs are reviewed; reviewed output is revalidated and rechecked; review failure is non-destructive.
close_reason: Structured output validation, partial recovery, deterministic findings, one-pass automatic/on-demand review, exact call counts, cancellation, recheck, and non-destructive failure are covered by provider/core and browser fixtures.

title: Build canonical prompt compiler

acceptance_criteria: Identical inputs compile identically; semantic sections are canonical; provider mechanisms may differ without changing policy meaning; snapshot and injection tests pass.
close_reason: Canonical compiler is deterministic, bounded, capability-aware, and separates privileged instructions from untrusted page/context/glossary/brief data; focused provider tests and strict types pass.

acceptance_criteria: Contracts are bounded, serializable, provider-neutral, runtime validated, migrated explicitly, and covered by deterministic tests.
close_reason: Implemented versioned runtime-validated TranslationPolicy, defaults, precedence, migration default, structured request/response and provider capability fields, stable fingerprinting, cache/recovery identity, and deterministic tests. pnpm typecheck and full pnpm test passed.
